text:
maria: quick idea - propose an "interface-slab" pattern to tighten hosted/dedicated/private handoffs. split concerns into control-slab (manifests, auth handshakes), data-slab (runtime requests, kvcache, batching/backpressure), ops-slab (telemetry, rate-limits, evictions). keep each slab's API minimal and explicit.

sanjeev: neat. avoids giant adapter surface. question: where should credential translation live? control-slab for initial mint, or ops-slab for runtime refresh?

joel: control-slab does initial translate + issues short leases. ops-slab exposes a refresh-hook that calls back to control-slab to mint new credentials, so ops never forges identity. keeps audit trail.

maria: agree. immutability of tenant identity after handshake reduces risk. ops-slab can only request new leases via a validate/mint endpoint.

infra-bot: deploy-note: provisional proto added at /infra/protos/slab_handshake_v1.proto

tasha: telemetry nuance: hosted wants token-level cost & traces; private wants redacted metrics. ops-slab should surface telemetry-adapter with a "redact_level" option in the manifest.

joel: also add a small backpressure status object in data-slab responses: {"status":"throttled","retry_after_ms":120} so clients and dedicated pools have consistent signals.

maria: example manifest snippet i sketched: ```yaml
slabs:
  control:
    auth_mode: delegated
    lease_ttl_s: 30
  data:
    batching: dynamic
    backpressure: enabled
  ops:
    telemetry_view: minimal | full
```

sanjeev: next steps: 1) slab_handshake RFC (owner: maria) 2) proto review (owner: joel) 3) ops adapter POC (owner: tasha). i'll book a 30m sync. :thumbsup: 

maria: i'll draft RFC this week and add compatibility tests for private deployments.

tasha: security nit - control-slab endpoints must be reachable only from trusted controlplane subnets in private mode. will add allowed gateway patterns to the RFC.

infra-bot: reminder: RFC template at /docs/rfcs/rfc-template.md

joel: ack, will review proto by EOD.

maria: goal is to reduce adapter diffs and make rollbacks simpler. shout if you see major gaps. thanks!
